author: GameTrailers
description: Your vaguely familiar, fully compliant neighborhood Agent Spider is here! Watch the Agent Spider reveal trailer to see this character in action. Agent Spider is the fourth fighter included in the Year 1 Character Pass and is swinging in this winter for Season 3 of Invincible VS. Invincible VS is available now on Xbox X|S, PC, and PlayStation 5 (PS5).
title: Invincible VS - Official Agent Spider Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the launch trailer for Royal Cartographer: Restore the Map, a single-player simulation game where you gather, rotate, place, and stitch together thousands of scattered map fragments. Discover exactly where every fragment belongs by matching coastlines, connecting rivers, following roads, and rebuilding mountain ranges. What begins as an overwhelming pile of torn paper becomes a complete map of the Kingdom. Royal Cartographer: Restore the Map is available now on PC (Steam).
title: Royal Cartographer: Restore the Map - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the announcement trailer for SKEF's Night Grill, a first-person horror game about cooking burgers, spotting impostors, and surviving gunfights developed by SKEF_5XX3. You work the night shift at a burger joint in a crime-ridden neighborhood. Serve customers, prepare food, and try to survive the night. But there's a problem. Not everyone who walks up to your window is human. SKEF's Night Grill is coming soon to PC (Steam). Wishlist it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5405700/SKEFs_Night_Grill/
title: SKEF's Night Grill - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the release date trailer for Baiacool - Tides of Olympus, a humorous 2D action-adventure game developed by Sasquatch with socks. PLay as a pufferfish on a quest to find Poseidon after receiving a cryptic message. Explore Greek god temples, solve puzzles, and fight enemies using a mystical stick that just won’t shut up. Uncover who's behind all of this – by saying just one word: cool. Baiacool - Tides of Olympus will be released on PC on November 3. Wishlist it and play the demo on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3797250/Baiacool__Tides_of_Olympus/
title: Baiacool - Tides of Olympus - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the teaser for Marvel Tokon Fighting Souls DLC Roster. Phoenix Cyclops is the first fighter, coming November 2nd, with the remaining roster being rounded out with Thor (Jane Foster), Venom and Jubilee. 

Marvel Tokon Fighting Souls is out now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).
title: Marvel Tokon Fighting Souls - Official Thor (Jane Foster) & Year 1 DLC Roster Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Fresh from EVO France, we got the first look at everyone's favorite boxing Kangaroo, Roger Jr! Appearing for the first time since Tekken Tag Tournament 2, this feisty boxing duo excels at getting into their opponent's face and overwhelming them with offence and mixups! With some new tricky moves guaranteed to catch your opponents off guard, Roger Jr. is back and punchier than ever! 

We also got our first in-game look at Yujiro Hanma, the final DLC fighter of Season 3, with a gameplay trailer set for the Tekken World Tour Finals on January 17th 2027. 
You can get boxing with Roger Jr. when the duo step into the ring for Season Pass holders on November 12th! TEKKEN 8 is out now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC (Steam) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Tekken 8 - Official Roger Jr. Gameplay Trailer (Ft. Yujiro Hanma Teaser)
